item.title: Repercussions of US-Israeli war extend beyond Iranian borders: IRGC spokesperson
item.description: Qazvin, IRNA – Spokesperson for the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Brigadier General Hossein Mohebi, referring to the fallout of the US-Israeli war of aggression, says the confrontation could have repercussions extending beyond Iran’s borders, affecting other nations as well.

item.title: Iran, 11 other countries condemn attacks on IAEA-safeguarded nuclear facilities
item.description: Tehran, IRNA - Iran, together with 11 other countries, issued a joint statement at the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly First Committee, calling for a complete prohibition on all forms of attack and threats against nuclear facilities under International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) safeguards.

Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86302038/Iran-11-other-countries-condemn-attacks-on-IAEA-safeguarded

item.title: Russia rejects claims of evacuating staff, nuclear plant specialists from Iran

item.title: Removing export barriers to Iraq, Pakistan, Afghanistan on agenda: Deputy FM
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran is reviewing regulations governing exporters’ obligations to address disruptions in transportation and logistics, with proposals also under consideration to remove barriers to exports to neighboring Iraq, Pakistan, and Afghanistan, a senior Foreign Ministry official says.

item.title: In photos: Tehran mourners mark Fatimiyya days at Enghelab Square

item.title: Iran discusses conservation of endangered species with IUCN
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – An Iranian delegation attending the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP17) has held talks with officials of the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) on protecting endangered species and expanding joint cooperation.
